howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Set crop margins
howto.text: Specify top / bottom / left / right margins to remove, in PDF points (1 pt = 1/72 inch).

howto.name: Download the cropped PDF
howto.text: Click Crop. Each page's MediaBox + CropBox is shrunk by the specified margins.

faq.a: Crop uses your manual margins (same on every page). Auto-Crop detects each page's actual content bounding box automatically.

faq.q: Will the cropped content be deleted from the file?
faq.a: No — only the visible region changes. The full page content is still in the file. To permanently remove the cropped data, run Flatten or Sanitize afterwards.

faq.q: How do I undo a crop?
faq.a: Re-open the PDF in PrivaTools Crop with negative margins to expand the box, or run Flatten which bakes the current crop in.
